```json
{
  "tools": [
    {"name": "caire", "url": "https://github.com/esimov/caire"},
    {"name": "Shan Shui Infinite", "url": "https://github.com/LingDong-/shan-shui-inf"}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "the picture: 1,960 x 896 | seams removed: 447 · width 1,513 px | caire | remove the seam: every row loses one pixel | width 1,960 px | energy measured again on the narrower picture | red: the 568 seams caire removed | esimov/caire | Code Issues Pull requests Actions Projects | caire / LICENSE | MIT License | Permissions: Commercial use, Modification, Distribution, Private use | Limitations: Liability, Warranty | Conditions: License and copyright notice | caire: carved to 1,392 x 896 | README License | Caire is a content aware image resize library based on Seam Carving for Content-Aware Image Resizing paper | How does it work | 504 func (p *Processor) shrink(img *image.NRGBA) (*image.NRGBA, error) { | 505 width, height := img.Bounds().Max.X, img.Bounds().Max.Y | 507 c := NewCarver(width, height) | 508 if _, err := c.ComputeSeams(p, img); err != nil { | 509 return nil, err | 511 seams := c.FindLowestEnergySeams(p) | 512 img = c.RemoveSeam(img, seams, p.Debug) | processor.go - esimov/caire@072a088 | caire's result: pagoda and houses, 0 pixels removed | caire - 1,960 x 896 | Thank you. 감사합니다. | @index.opensource | @hyun2xyz",
  "key_claims": [
    "caire is a content-aware image resizing library that removes low-energy pixel seams to narrow an image without uniformly squeezing it",
    "It works by measuring edge energy, finding a seam of one pixel per row with the lowest cumulative energy, removing it, then recomputing energy and repeating",
    "In this example, 568 seams were removed to resize a 1,960×896 generated landscape down to 1,392×896",
    "The pagoda, house, and pavilion regions lost no pixels in this run, while parts of the trees did lose pixels",
    "The process is based purely on edge energy and does not understand which objects are semantically important",
    "The input image was a program-generated landscape (Shan Shui Infinite by Lingdong Huang)",
    "caire itself calculated the seams, energy values, and resized pixels; the color maps, enlarged pixel diagrams, labels, layout, and ordinary-resize comparison were added separately by the creators",
    "caire is MIT licensed, allowing commercial use, modification, distribution, and private use, provided the copyright and license notice are kept"
  ],
  "info_channel": "on-screen"
}
```
